name: Stock News API
tagline: Ticker-tagged stock and crypto news headlines for sentiment analysis and market apps
description: Stock News API provides structured stock-market news articles and videos tagged to company tickers, with filtering by ticker, topic, sentiment, source, and date range. It supports market dashboards, sentiment analysis, and trading research; crypto news is offered through the separate Crypto News API sister service.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (e.g. token=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: No ongoing free plan. A one-time 5-day trial includes 100 API calls and access to all features; cancel before it ends to avoid the selected paid plan being charged.
pricing.paid_plans: Paid tiers for higher volume and advanced filters

rate_limits: Basic: 20,000 calls/month; Premium: 50,000 calls/month; Business: custom monthly volume. The Tickers DB endpoint may be accessed once per day by non-trial accounts.
use_cases: fetch latest news headlines for a stock ticker
filter crypto or equity news by sentiment
pull ticker-tagged articles for a date range
power a market sentiment dashboard from structured news
